chapter: Los Angeles, Chet Baker and film beginnings
title: Jerry Lewis's kindness to Frank Socolow
summary: Kirchner and Mandel talk about Jerry Lewis paying hospital bills when Socolow's son was badly burned.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I’m told by the way, I guess Frank Socolow met Jerry and became close friends with him when Jerry was playing up in the Catskills.
Yeah Jerry’s a good guy actually.
Loved music, still does I guess.
Apparently when Frank and Joanne’s son had a serious auto accident and was badly burned…
He picked up all the hospital bills.
That’s right, Jerry could be very kind when he wanted to.
Yeah, he really came through for Frank.
